title: Repository private, all rights reserved
body:
**The repository goes private and carries a LICENSE stating all rights reserved; the manuals stay where they are.**

Camden's answer to block 06.03 (2026-10-13, desktop): option (a), no words added. Option (a) in full: "Make the repository private, and state 'all rights reserved' in a LICENSE file. The manuals stay where they are, the phone keeps working through its token (the token becomes required for reading too), CI keeps running, nothing is rewritten. Nobody outside sees the record; a sponsor showcase would need a separate public face later."

Reasoning: the recommendation was (a); it stops the redistribution of copyrighted manuals without rewriting history (no force-push).

Consequences: a LICENSE file (all rights reserved) is added at the repository root in this pass; switching the repository to private is a GitHub setting only Camden can change (the tool cannot), and the phone's token must have read access to it. No manuals are moved or history rewritten; the intake's bulk still leaves git by parse row (T2).
